## Circular to Licensed Corporations

## which are licensed for Types 1, 2, 3 and/or 8 regulated activities

## Information request

In  order  to  enhance  the  Commission's  understanding  of  the  risk  exposures  of  licensed corporations which are licensed for Types 1, 2, 3 and/or 8 regulated activities, we would like to request these licensed corporations to report information on their proprietary positions in securities  and  specified  investments  as  at  30  June  2004.    Please  complete  section  1  of  the enclosed Form.

For those that do not hold any proprietary positions, please indicate so in the same section.

Separately,  we  request  for  certain  information  about  the  manpower  employed  by  these licensed  corporations.    Please  provide  the  information  by  completing  section  2  of  the enclosed Form.

Please return the completed Form to the Intermediaries Supervision Department on or before 21 July 2004 .

If  you  have  any  questions,  pleases  contact  your  responsible  case  officer  of  Intermediaries Supervision Department.

Intermediaries Supervision Department Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission
